productBrief: cortex: synthetic focus-group platform with persistent AI personas
contradictions: Panelists disagree on whether persistent AI personas are too abstract or valuable.
Technical skeptics question the empirical evidence while user advocates emphasize the perceived realism.
painPoints: Lack of concrete data on the effectiveness of AI personas in providing actionable feedback.
Concerns about the value proposition and price point for synthetic feedback.
opportunities: Run a pilot with a few users to evaluate the AI personas' effectiveness in real-world scenarios.
Provide more tangible examples of how AI personas can improve feedback quality.
rawSummary: Panelists expressed concerns about the clarity and value of persistent AI personas, emphasizing the need for concrete data. Technical skeptics highlighted the lack of empirical evidence, while user advocates noted the perceived realism and usefulness in providing clear, actionable feedback.

personaInsights.keyContribution: Users need more concrete examples of how AI personas can provide actionable feedback.
There is a need for clearer communication on the benefits of AI personas beyond just cost.
As a product manager, I see the importance of balancing user feedback clarity with the development process.
Technical skepticism towards the reliability and accuracy of AI-generated feedback needs to be addressed.
Existing user feedback is often too abstract, lacking specific details that could be actionable.
The current pricing model for AI personas does not clearly reflect the value they bring to users.
